description: This file is a shell script for managing a DHCPv6 server service, including configuration generation, starting, stopping, and handling events related to DHCPv6 operations.

methods.name: prepare_dhcpv6s_config
methods.description: Generates the DHCPv6 server configuration file based on current system settings.

methods.name: restore_dhcpv6s_duid
methods.description: Restores the DHCPv6 server DUID from NVRAM if not already set.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes service parameters, retrieves configuration data.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the DHCPv6 server, setting up configuration and ensuring conditions are met.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the DHCPv6 server and saves DUID to persistent storage.
